pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/provider-key-precedence.ts:63 A blank GEMINI_API_KEY is treated as missing, so a later alias such as GOOGLE_API_KEY still supplies the credential.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/llm-config.ts:357 An empty store emits nothing so the Claude CLI default stays outside the rows. That is the scalar case.
app/_lib/llm-config.ts:389 The child receives one assembled JSON object. No file names a parent file.
app/_lib/llm-secret.ts:17 KP_SECRET_PREVIOUS re-encrypts ciphertext. It is not a bounded backup of a settings file.

app/_lib/provider-key-precedence.ts:59 Order is byom, then platform, then env, and a decrypt error throws. The return value does not name which source won, and buildLlmConfigEnv folds the rows into one map.
app/_lib/llm-config.ts:294 A use case with no row follows the * pin, a sibling key, and is resolved again on read.
app/_lib/llm-config.ts:73 Providers are one closed list with a membership predicate. saveProviderKey itself is typed and does not call this predicate.
app/_lib/provider-key-precedence.ts:63 The stored-row rung returns an empty key and stops. The env-alias rung uses truthiness, so a present blank name loses to the next alias.
app/_lib/llm-config.ts:365 Assembly lists both tables once. There is no cross-call cache, so a later resolve reads the store again.
app/_lib/llm-config.ts:192 The write door can report stale. No control is rendered in this module.
app/_lib/llm-config.ts:367 Nothing configured is omitted so the default is not stored. toUseCaseEntry keeps only positive integer maxTokens and timeoutS.

pairs.registryProposal: Say that an alias list in a read-only source is presence-decides-precedence, and that an empty string is present. This chain already stops on an empty stored key and still truth-tests the env alias rung.

pairs.evidence: app/features/insights/analytics/AnalyticsInlineNumberSave.tsx:77 A failed blur-save announces the error and leaves the field showing the number that was not stored.

techniques.evidence: app/features/insights/analytics/AnalyticsGoalsEditor.tsx:59 A blank goal is absence, not a shipped 50% entry reapplied into a collection.

app/features/insights/analytics/stageDwellGate.ts:123 A shipped role default is not painted as a team decision. The cadence input passes null team days unless cadenceSource is team, and a null save clears back to that default.
app/features/insights/analytics/AnalyticsGoalsEditor.tsx:24 Every stage goal arrives on one prop. The editors do not fetch per metric.
app/features/insights/analytics/AnalyticsInlineNumberSave.tsx:77 Blur-save is the right model and the alert is honest. The catch does not put the draft back to the stored value.

app/features/insights/analytics/AnalyticsThresholdSuggestion.tsx:15 The auto-reject floor waits for Apply and is sealed in history. Goals and channel spend commit on blur. The split is per component, with no shared kind field.

app/features/insights/analytics/thresholdHistoryRows.ts:23 A sealed floor record carries previous, next, at, and approvedBy, and the strip renders it. Goal and spend edits have no such strip in these files.
app/features/insights/analytics/inlineNumberSavePlan.ts:37 One planner parses, rejects non-finite and negative input, and turns blank or zero into null so the row is cleared.

pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: app/features/settings/branding/BrandingTab.tsx:108 The branding form's unsaved guard listens only for a full page unload, so a workspace tab change can drop a dirty form without a prompt.

techniques.evidence: app/features/settings/branding/BrandingTab.tsx:160 Reset returns the last saved brand. There is no shipped collection of default entries.

app/features/settings/organization/OrganizationTab.tsx:28 Org settings are a cookie and a workspace default. The backup panel is an on-demand organization database export with a dry-run, not a rotation of a settings file before each save.
app/features/settings/branding/BrandingTab.tsx:131 The brand payload is three named fields, a strict section, not a document that keeps unknown members.
app/features/settings/organization/OrganizationTab.tsx:152 The tab does not fetch each setting. Both values are already on the document.

app/features/settings/branding/BrandingTab.tsx:108 Dirty is compared to the saved baseline, and a failed currency write calls setCurrency(previous). The org name debounces and flushes on unmount. The branding explicit form does not prompt on in-app tab changes.
app/features/settings/organization/OrganizationTab.tsx:27 Name, language, currency, and brand are identity preferences. No ceiling or flag is in these files.

app/features/settings/organization/OrganizationTab.tsx:109 An unknown locale is refused before write. An unrecognized app locale is shown as en. Branding blocks save when the accent is not a legible hex.
